## 🏢 Company Overview

ZEALL FRP Grating is a leading China-based manufacturer of FRP (Fiberglass Reinforced Plastic) grating and custom composite solutions. With 20+ years of manufacturing experience, we serve 40+ countries worldwide with high-quality, corrosion-resistant FRP products.

**Key Facts:**
- 20+ Years Manufacturing Experience
- 40+ Countries Served
- 10,000+ Tons Annual Production Capacity
- 100% In-House Manufacturing
- ISO 9001 Certified
- 20+ Year Limited Warranty
- 1 PC Minimum Order Quantity
- 541+ Global Customers
- 4.9/5 Customer Rating
- 65%+ Repurchase Rate

## 📦 Product Catalog (8 Main Products)

### 1. FRP Molded Grating
- Thickness: 25mm, 30mm, 38mm, 50mm
- Mesh: 19×19mm, 38×38mm, 40×40mm, 50×50mm
- Surface: Concave/Meniscus Top, Grit-top, Smooth, Covered Solid
- Resin: Isophthalic Polyester, Vinyl-Ester, Phenolic
- Features: Bidirectional equal strength, corrosion resistant, non-conductive

### 2. FRP Pultruded Grating
- Heavy-duty load bearing
- Bearing bar design
- Large span capability
- Resin: Isophthalic, Vinyl-Ester, Phenolic

### 3. FRP Solid Covers
- Full coverage, no openings
- Anti-slip surface options
- Corrosion resistant

### 4. FRP Pultruded Profiles
- I-beam, Channel, Angle, Square Tube, Round Tube, Flat Bar
- Structural replacement for steel
- Corrosion resistant, non-conductive

### 5. FRP Handrail & Stair Systems
- Round tube & square tube handrails
- Ladders with safety cages
- Stair treads
- OSHA & EN compliant

### 6. FRP Custom Fabrication
- Custom sizes and shapes
- CNC cutting
- Engineering support

### 7. Grating Clips & Fasteners
- M-Clip, C-Clip, L-Clip, Z-Clip
- SS304, SS316, Hot-dip galvanized
- Base plates, saddle washers

### 8. Custom FRP Products
- Fiberglass Mesh & Tape
- Custom composite solutions
- Engineering design support

## Product Categories (8 Products)

1. **FRP Molded Grating** - 25/30/38/50mm, 19x19/38x38/40x40/50x50mm mesh
2. **FRP Pultruded Grating** - Heavy-duty, large span, load bearing
3. **FRP Covers & Panels** - Solid covers, anti-slip surfaces
4. **FRP Pultruded Profiles** - I-beam, channel, angle, tube, flat bar
5. **FRP Handrail & Stair System** - OSHA compliant, ladders, stair treads
6. **Custom FRP Fabrication** - CNC cutting, custom sizes
7. **Grating Clips & Fasteners** - M/C/L/Z clips, SS304/SS316
8. **Custom FRP Products** - Fiberglass mesh, tape, composites

## Resin Systems

- **Polyester**: General purpose, cost-effective
- **Isophthalic Polyester**: Wastewater, moderate corrosion
- **Vinyl Ester**: Heavy acid-alkali, marine, salt spray
- **Phenolic**: Flame retardant, high-voltage insulation

## Surface Options

- **Concave / Meniscus Top**: Standard, moderate anti-slip
- **Grit Top**: Highest anti-slip (R13), oily/wet areas
- **Smooth**: Decorative, clean rooms
- **Covered Solid**: Water-tight, full coverage

## Key Advantages vs Steel

- 75% lighter than steel
- Never rusts or corrodes
- Non-conductive, non-magnetic
- Low maintenance, no painting
- No scrap value (anti-theft)
- Easy on-site cutting
- 20+ year service life
